primary_endpoint: Proportion with improvement in liver fibrosis of at least one stage without worsening of NASH at 48 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: Primary endpoint: 5/47 (11%) with semaglutide vs 7/24 (29%) with placebo; OR 0.28 (95% CI 0.06–1.24), p=0.087. NASH resolution also did not differ significantly (p=0.29).
safety_signal: Adverse events occurred in 42/47 (89%) vs 19/24 (79%); serious adverse events in 6/47 (13%) vs 2/24 (8%) with semaglutide vs placebo. Nausea (45% vs 17%), diarrhoea (19% vs 8%), and vomiting (17% vs 0%) were more common with semaglutide; no decompensating events or deaths.
